decisive_items: marked perilobular and periductal mixed chronic inflammatory infiltrate enriched in eosinophils
Hypereosinophilic syndrome was excluded from consideration
response.rationale: Histology shows a mixed chronic inflammatory infiltrate enriched in eosinophils with no granulomata, and hypereosinophilic syndrome is excluded; the idiopathic qualifier fits the absence of systemic symptoms/known cause, slightly more specific than eosinophilic mastitis alone.

rejected.why: Only seasonal allergic rhinitis, not sufficient for breast eosinophilic infiltrate.
Histology explicitly states no granulomata, contradicting granulomatous mastitis.
